scope: Prevent ambiguous physical HEADER timestamp evidence in the selected AC1012 partial-output audit.
checks: The reusable ASCII/Binary tag check now requires exactly one HEADER section, one complete instance of each selected timestamp, the expected group 40 value and no extra value in that variable.

Duplicate HEADER and duplicate TDCREATE controls are rejected for each of four outputs, and the unchanged tag stream succeeds on retry. Existing source-time mutation, 143-value, eight-reference and strict-preservation checks also pass.
limits: This guards selected physical timestamp evidence only; it does not qualify arbitrary HEADER variables, native semantics, or complete-file export.
